semiconductor_relevance: High — Umicore Thin Film Products AG specializes in precious metal-based surface coatings and PVD materials, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Umicore Thin Film Products AG provides advanced electroplating solutions and PVD materials for the semiconductor industry, focusing on high-quality surface coatings and thin film applications. Their offerings include innovative copper electroplating additives and a broad portfolio of sputtering targets and evaporation materials tailored for various semiconductor applications.
capabilities: Copper electroplating additives for advanced packaging applications
PVD materials for microelectronic and optoelectronic applications

regional_presence.Liechtenstein: Umicore's location in Balzers is certified in accordance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and OHSAS 18001 standards.
